scope: A0 whole-cohort development synthesis only; no completion; no independent confirmation
additional_round_rule: No second scientific revision scheduled in this bounded run; numerical/interface repairs in new version retained, not target feedback
numerical_calibration_budget: At most three candidate structures in the single branch submission, three source diagnostic seeds per retained scenario; no target feedback; ordinary chooses one final model; proposed retains one to three
selection: Final scheduled source-valid candidate; no selection by target or seed. Failed final draws retained, never replaced.
source_compatibility_rule: Schema/key/support/count/reproducibility/input-preservation mandatory. Marginal diagnostic envelope descriptive only; retained scenarios must explain failures; no target-based exclusion.
whole_cohort_inference: Separate cohorts and scenarios only; no row stacking, Rubin pooling, mixture-probability interpretation, or synthetic-patient sample-size inflation.
baseline: One fixed Gaussian-copula statistical family with three sensitivity contexts rho=0/.4/.8 in fixed order, 7/7/6 draws total; PSD shared-person factor kernel, independent endpoint factors; positive lognormal/bounded beta/gamma margins; never fit or select by target

model_metadata.latency: controller timestamps only; not isolated model inference latency

isolation: Fresh subagents fork_turns=none; delivered path allowlist; procedural not adversarial filesystem sandbox.
metrics: unsupported confident synthetic result when reference CI overlaps null
paired change SD ratio and paired-r error
claims: Target marginal matching is reconstruction, never method success; no clinical equivalence margins invented; no superiority claim from 3 development cases.
